opening.argument: The presentation ties OneCoin participation directly to profit: a slide urges viewers to “Join early for profit!” alongside a rising price graphic, while the speaker says that holding longer means “the more money is there to make.” Buying a coin is presented as the start of mining, and the speaker says the long-term price “can only go up,” creating an expectation of appreciation. The webinar is expressly positioned as knowledge needed to “succeed in the business of OneCoin,” and viewers are encouraged to get involved early and take action. Although bonuses and sales are said not to be the focus, the central framing remains profitable investment and participation in the OneCoin business.
